summary: Alkermes plc filed a Form 8-K announcing orphan drug designations for alixorexton from the FDA and European Commission for idiopathic hypersomnia and narcolepsy, respectively. The filing is a routine disclosure of regulatory milestones with no deal terms. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are involved. It is not a special situation; it is an operational update from the issuer. The 8-K reports items 7.01 and 8.01 exclusively, with no M&A, activism, or capital structure event. No arbitrage angle exists.
